claim: Audit the consumer against the issuer for drift, and audit every identity the consumer should bind to its own state, such as its ledger id; check that each injected port can express every path the rule names, such as approval-chain and issuer revocation.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: green suites missed that the consumer never checked the ledger id and that its revocation port could only express a grant-level revocation.
